absent: Backing page creation and destruction mechanics and per-processor address mapping for chunks.
Chunk creation, destruction, slot sizing, free slot indices and depopulation queue admission rules.
Hint maintenance algorithms for allocation and free paths beyond the observed refresh entry points.
Translation flush scope and cross-processor synchronization requirements for unmapping.
Numeric values of allocation quantum, unit extent, block width, watermarks, thresholds and slot counts.
Ownership extension layout, tag storage and lifetime beyond the observed indexed store.
Balance work scheduling triggers, workqueue identity and retry or cancellation rules.
Statistics, tracing, leak tracking and memory accounting payload definitions.
Reserved chunk provisioning, immutable chunk lifecycle and isolation entry conditions.

findings.text: A public percpu allocation service accepts a byte size, byte alignment, reserved selector and page allocation flags and yields a percpu address on success or null when validation, space search, backing population or interruption fails.
A work handler provides the background balance entry point and runs free, reclaim, populate and final free phases under combined mutex and spin protection with constrained reclaim context.

Requested alignment is raised to the minimum allocation quantum, size is rounded up to that quantum, and requests are rejected when empty, exceeding the minimum unit extent, demanding page-exceeding alignment, or using non power of two alignment.

Allocation search first consults a chunk-wide hint to skip unsuitable chunks, derives a start position from scan and contiguous hints, and then enumerates candidate extents until a map end sentinel indicates exhaustion.

Free enumeration reports contiguous unused runs including spans across block boundaries, while fit enumeration additionally enforces length and alignment, accumulates prefixes across blocks, and records failure by positioning at the total map extent.

Reservation scans only a bounded window ahead of the hinted start, records the largest skipped gap for hint refresh, marks allocation and boundary occupancy, decrements free accounting, advances the first free marker when consumed, refreshes allocation hints and reclassifies the chunk.
Atomic context restricts candidate extents to fully backed page ranges derived from bit positions, and on encountering an unbacked gap advances the search to the end of that gap.

Bitmap search locates the first aligned clear run of requested length, and while skipping occupied intersections remembers the largest skipped clear run with preference for stronger alignment on ties; overflow past the search end is reported as failure.

Memory accounting and allocation tagging each have an active variant that charges and attaches ownership or profiling data through per-offset extensions and a dormant variant that accepts unconditionally and performs no work.

The subsystem maintains a reserve of empty backed pages between low and high watermarks, scheduling background work when below the low mark and refilling from densely used chunks first, with full refill after an atomic failure; reclaim keeps backed pages packed toward the chunk start.

Chunk metadata mutation and list placement require the central percpu spin protection, asserted in reintegration, reservation, depopulation accounting and all balance helpers; allocation uses interrupt saving acquisition while background helpers use interrupt acquisition.

Blocking allocation and background balance serialize backing store changes under a dedicated allocation mutex, acquired killably unless no-fail semantics are requested and never acquired in atomic context.

The central spin protection is released around backing page creation and destruction, chunk creation and destruction, translation flush and voluntary rescheduling, then reacquired before updating accounting or list state.

A block descriptor tracks free run information through left edge, right edge, largest interior run with its start, a scan position with its length, and a first free marker used to skip fully examined regions.

A chunk aggregates a block descriptor array plus a summary descriptor, allocation occupancy, boundary markers, backing presence, page and byte accounting, empty backed page counts, isolation and immutability markers, optional ownership extensions, a base address and list linkage.

Chunks migrate among size-indexed placement lists, a free list, a depopulation queue and a sidelined park state; isolation removes a chunk from allocation discovery until reintegration restores its empty page contribution and reclassifies it, while fully free chunks return to active placement.

Allocation proceeds from validation and accounting pre-check through reserved or size-ordered normal search, creation of a fresh chunk when no free list headroom remains, population of missing backing pages with rollback on failure, zeroing on every possible processor, and tracing plus ownership attachment before returning.

Background balance executes an ordered cycle of freeing surplus fully free chunks except one survivor, draining the depopulation queue with reverse-order unmapping and batched flush, refilling the backed reserve with possible new chunk creation and retry, then freeing fully unbacked surplus chunks.

Backing allocations mask caller flags to a small allowlist and forbid no-fail and reclaim-heavy modes, while background work forces constrained reclaim context, preventing deadlock between filesystem or input locks and the allocation mutex.

Allocation failures emit rate-limited warnings capped at a small count with stack capture only in blocking context, flag atomic exhaustion for aggressive refill, and background paths assert against destroying or draining immutable chunks.

Minimum allocation quantum and its shift define the accounting granularity linking bit positions to bytes, minimum unit extent bounds single requests, and block bit width bounds per-block hint arithmetic.
Low and high watermarks bound the empty backed page reserve and a failure threshold slot index controls demotion of chunks that miss fit during search.
